div.h3: Managing references between requirements and satisfying artifacts
div.p: There are two complementary ways to record traceability between a Requirements statement and an artifact that satisfies it. Where the satisfying artifact is authored or maintained in coordination with the Requirements resource, it is typical for the satisfying artifact to point to the requirement using the Requirements Satisfied extension. This keeps the satisfaction assertion with the artifact whose design fulfills the requirement.

The Requirements.statement.satisfiedBy element is useful when the requirement is met by a pre-existing artifact, such as the base FHIR specification or a national implementation guide, or when the Requirements author cannot coordinate changes to the artifact that satisfies the requirement. In those cases, the Requirements resource can assert the artifact, element, or other URI that satisfies the requirement without requiring a change to the satisfying artifact.
